NO PRODUCT WAS RETURNED FOR EVALUATION. SHOULD NEW RELEVANT INFORMATION BECOME AVAILABLE, A SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT WILL BE SUBMITTED.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT AN OCCLUSION ALARM OCCURRED. CUSTOMER'S BLOOD GLUCOSE WAS 135 MG/DL. REPORTEDLY, THE PUMP SUPPLIES WERE CHANGED TO ADDRESS THE ISSUE AND INSULIN DELIVERY WAS RESUMED.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT THE PUMP FELL, AND THE TOUCH SCREEN BECAME SHATTERED AND UNRESPONSIVE. THERE WAS NO ADVERSE IMPACT TO CUSTOMER¿S BLOOD GLUCOSE LEVEL. REPORTEDLY, CUSTOMER REVERTED TO BACKUP PUMP FOR INSULIN THERAPY.

IT WAS REPORTED THAT THE CUSTOMER WENT TO THE EMERGENCY ROOM AND WAS SUBSEQUENTLY ADMITTED TO THE INTENSIVE CARE UNIT DUE TO A BLOOD GLUCOSE (BG) LEVEL OF 35 MG/DL; CAUSE WAS NOT KNOWN. REPORTEDLY, THERE WAS A BLOOD CLOT IN THE CUSTOMER¿S LUNG. CUSTOMER CONSUMED CARBOHYDRATES AND WAS TREATED WITH BLOOD THINNERS AND INTRAVENOUS LIQUIDS.
